title: Cosmic Surreal Eye
description: A highly detailed surreal painting of a giant human eye dominating the composition, featuring a vertical slit pupil with glowing yellow highlights. The iris and sclera contain text, moon phases, and small celestial bodies, surrounded by floating planets, stars, and nebulae in a cosmic background framed by film strip borders.
prompt: Surreal cosmic painting of a massive detailed human eye with a vertical slit pupil glowing bright yellow, the sclera filled with white text and moon phase illustrations, multiple floating moons and planets drifting in a colorful nebula of red, green and purple, entire composition framed by old film strip borders with text, intricate symbolic details, mystical atmosphere
